title: Old Windows Aren't Melting
pause_note: Short format v3: 20-30 s, claim first, loop ending

beats: Some old panes are thicker at the bottom, so people say glass flows.
But at room temperature, glass would take far longer than the age of the universe to sag.
Old glass was spun or blown by hand, so it came out uneven.
Builders often set the thick edge down.
It was uneven from the day it was made.
